Very disappointed
Sep 2026 • Family
Very disappointed by the welcome at El Fondouk Djerba.

Especially by the French lady who manages the restaurant, whose attitude seemed very unprofessional to me.

I admit that there was indeed a sign indicating that it was forbidden to take photos, but I had not seen it. I therefore perfectly understand that I can be reminded of this rule. On the other hand, his way of reacting to us was unpleasant and, in my opinion, not at all professional.

What bothered me most was that other people present were taking photos and filming normally. Even on social media, you regularly see customers sharing their photos and videos of the place. However, our group seemed to be the subject of particular and constant attention on his part.

A simple polite remark would have been more than enough. The way customers are welcomed and treated is also part of the experience, and unfortunately, this really spoiled our visit.

Beautiful decor, mundane cuisine and perfectible Service
Sep 2025 • Couples
I had heard a lot about this restaurant and I couldn’t wait to try it, but the experience was not up to scratch. The setting is nice and neat, but the kitchen remains basic for a daily menu at this price, nothing exceptional, comparable to what could be found in any other medium-range establishment. Prices are high compared to quality (e.g. a single brick at 22 TND).

Service, too, leaves something to be desired. Although the restaurant is indicated as open until 6pm, we felt strong pressure from the staff as early as 4pm to speed up the meal, bring the dessert and pay the bill, when we had arrived around 3pm and had only an hour and a half to enjoy lunch.

We were offered tea accompanied by small Tunisian pastries, which was appreciable. However, when we paid in cash, we remitted an amount above the rating, and change was not returned. We were not asked if this should be considered a tip. Perhaps it is a local practice, but in my experience, it is customary to first ask the customer the amount of tip desired. This episode marked me and reinforced my feeling of discomfort.

In summary: pleasant setting, but disappointing cuisine, exaggerated prices and perfectible Service. I recommend choosing only the main course, without a full menu, to avoid disappointment.
